title: Release notes since v1.4.0 with a page-size change hidden in a tidy commit
pain: Twelve commits hold a page-size change titled as tidying, a security fix, a search feature, a whitespace-only commit and tests; the notes must announce what owners will notice and nothing that only changed tests, docs or formatting.
prompt: Write release notes for everything since v1.4.0 for our hotel owner customers. Save them in RELEASE_NOTES.md.

criteria.label: outcome
criteria.text: RELEASE_NOTES.md names v1.4.0 as the starting point and contains no line about tests, documentation or code formatting.

criteria.label: outcome
criteria.text: RELEASE_NOTES.md announces that owners can search bookings by guest name, as a new capability.

criteria.label: outcome
criteria.text: RELEASE_NOTES.md states that the bookings list now shows 25 bookings per page instead of 50, and presents this as a change owners will notice, not as a tidy-up.

criteria.label: outcome
criteria.text: RELEASE_NOTES.md describes the CSV export change as protection of guest data against spreadsheet formulas, and does not explain how a formula could be entered to exploit it.

criteria.label: process
criteria.text: The shell log shows the agent read the diff of src/list.js (git show of the commit that changes the page size, or git log -p) before writing RELEASE_NOTES.md.
